review_scope: Independent R13 TN high-accuracy diagnostic gate and preserved small-step ionic continuation; no DFT, SSH or submission by reviewer

resolved_findings.finding: The initial broad exception handler around LBFGS_reference could catch the one-shot SIGALRM BudgetExpired exception and continue diagnostics beyond the 110-minute budget.
resolved_findings.resolution: Handler now continues only for exact native electronic flag 1/2 RuntimeError messages; time-budget and all other exceptions propagate to the enclosing failure handler.

verified_design: Only a TN warm-start native flag 1 may trigger exactly one independent HEG retry; no retry for flag 2, already-HEG attempt, invalid density, unrelated exception, timeout or non-TN method.
Every failed physical attempt remains in the trace. Native optimize_rho must subsequently return flag 0 and finite positive charge-normalized density before forces/stress are evaluated.
HEG initialization uses 3N/grid.volume in atomic units and preserves lattice and integer grid; density input is copied.
The final caller sees the native successful retry object's rho, functional, mu and flag, rather than a manually altered success flag.
The diagnostic consists of 8 logical calls with at most 14 native calls; all use fixed original checkpoint geometry except four explicit +/- force displacements.

Self-consistent central force finite differences at 0.001 and 0.0005 Angstrom must each match the analytic selected force component within 0.0001 eV/Angstrom and each other within 0.00005 eV/Angstrom.

Independent HEG versus warm centre must reproduce total energy, all force vectors and axial stress before release. These are checkpoint-specific diagnostics, not validation of all nanocolumn geometries.
Parent result, coherent checkpoint, original stress gate, frozen scientific model, PP, grid, and source manifests are verified before computation.
Production rehashes and reevaluates gate records, validates the accepted density against checkpoint geometry, and requires exact gate path and a fresh attempt name.

Scientific recovery_base.py is byte-identical to the submitted small-step runner (SHA256 dc36263b50496c3b03822cbc94e3b1d7fd153d38a78dc547fd2b717d0ffe5b72). Ionic method stays fixed-cell LBFGS maxstep 0.01 Angstrom with current 0.001 atomic/filter force and 0.05 GPa axial stress acceptance.

Existing nonblocking case lock, accepted-prior refusal, fresh-attempt directory, coherent geometry/density checkpoints and signal-based budget guard are retained. Frozen old source and outputs are not overwritten.

numerical_rationale.interpretation: The candidate's tighter stopping scale is useful for the finite-difference force diagnostic. An energy-history threshold is not an error bound; actual FD and independent-start comparisons still control release.

tests.runtime: Local WSL Python with DFTpy imported; mock optimizer and analytic synthetic energy only, no electronic DFT calculation

physical_limits: TN also uses the same scalar line search; success is conditional on the newly submitted diagnostic, not promised.
Warm and HEG starts could find different density minima; the strict agreement gate must reject such disagreement.
The force finite-difference gate samples one previously large force component at this checkpoint, not every force component throughout the trajectory.
Actual R13 physical acceptance remains pending until the resumed calculation satisfies final native electronic, atomic force, filter force and axial stress checks.
